subject: Clearview MAP: sequencing, owner assignments & kickoff scheduling
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cortez <emily.cortez@clearview.health>
Cc: Derek Liu <derek.liu@clearview.health>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clearview MAP: sequencing, owner assignments & kickoff scheduling

Hi Emily — great to connect on the call earlier. Per our discussion, I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) that outlines the high-level milestones, recommended week-by-week sequencing, and proposed owner assignments from both Clearview and Redwood.

Quick notes in this draft: 
- Kickoff & alignment (Week 0): discovery checklist + SSO onboarding prep (owner: Hannah / Clearview IT)
- Data ingestion proof-of-concept (Week 1–2): API keys, sample payload, staging dataset (owner: Ben)
- Model tuning & prompt set validation (Week 3–4): evals, quality gates (owner: Monica)
- Acceptance & go/no-go (Week 6): acceptance criteria, performance SLAs, docs handoff

Can you confirm: 
1) Who at Clearview should be listed as the primary technical owner for data access (we have Derek on procurement but need an engineering owner)?
2) Any blackout dates for late May/early June that would affect the week-by-week plan?
3) Preferred kickoff window — we have Tue/Thu mornings PDT open next week.

I attached: Clearview_MAP_v1.xlsx (map + owners) and a draft SOW PDF to capture the milestone-linked deliverables. Once we lock owners and kickoff, Ben will produce a narrow-run checklist (detailed tasks) and Monica will align the eval/acceptance criteria.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | (415) 555-0143
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Clearview_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: Clearview_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF summary)

From: Emily Cortez <emily.cortez@clearview.health>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Derek Liu <derek.liu@clearview.health>
Date: 2026-05-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clearview MAP: sequencing, owner assignments & kickoff scheduling

Hi Hannah — thanks for the rapid turnaround and the thoughtful layout. This looks like a good starting point.

Notes from our side: 
- I'll be the project sponsor and will own procurement coordination, but the technical owner will be Priya Malhotra (email cc'ed below in a follow-up — she's our lead data engineer and will handle credentials/data access).
- We have an internal code freeze May 27–29 that could impact the Week 1 ingestion window if we don't get keys before then. Can we aim to start staging ingestion on June 1 to avoid risk?
- Tue/Thu mornings sound good — can we target Thursday, May 21 at 10:00 AM PDT for kickoff? If not, Tuesday the 19th works after 11 AM.

Also, can you include a brief line in the MAP about expected artifact handoffs (who provides sanitized data, what format, and who issues API tokens)? Derek — tagging you for procurement timeline and PO cadence.

Thanks,
Emily
Director of Product, Clearview Health
emily.cortez@clearview.health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Cortez <emily.cortez@clearview.health>, Derek Liu <derek.liu@clearview.health>
Date: 2026-05-19T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clearview MAP: sequencing, owner assignments & kickoff scheduling

Thanks — adding a more detailed engineering sequencing so we can align on concrete handoffs. Draft below; I'll add task cards in our shared Drive after Emily confirms Priya as the technical owner.

Week 0 (Pre-kickoff, target: complete before May 21 kickoff):
- Exchange IP allowlist + SSO test accounts (Clearview IT)
- Share sanitized sample dataset (CSV export, up to 5k rows) (Clearview Data)
- Redwood to provision sandbox API keys and a staging endpoint (Ben)

Week 1 (June 1–7):
- Staging ingestion and schema validation (Ben + Priya)
- Log-forwarding test (sample logs to Redwood staging)
- Small spike: end-to-end request/response cycle, capture latency metrics

Week 2 (June 8–14):
- Prompt engineering iteration with 3 representative user flows (Monica)
- Baseline evaluation run (quality metrics, false-positive checks)

Week 3–4 (June 15–28):
- Larger tuning & regression tests; fallback policy configuration
- Run acceptance tests against the MAP pass/fail matrix

Acceptance window (Week 6):
- Acceptance sign-off meeting; handoff of runbooks, runbooks review, and knowledge transfer session (owners: Monica + Hannah + Clearview leads)

Dependencies / riskiest items: 
- API token provisioning timeline (procurement + security review)
- Sanitized sample availability (data stewardship)
- Any compliance requirements that require additional review (DPA / SOC items)

Action items from Redwood: 
1) Ben: provision staging keys and share endpoint details by May 21
2) Monica: prepare prompt test-set template and initial evaluation rubric by May 25
3) Hannah: lock kickoff date and send calendar invite with agenda

I will not loop in Infra unless we hit kernel-level performance work — we should be able to run everything on our sandbox fleet.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Clearview MAP: sequencing, owner assignments & kickoff scheduling

Emily — thanks, this is perfect. Thursday May 21 at 10:00 AM PDT is on my calendar; invite sent and included a short agenda (discovery checklist, data handoff, immediate risks, next 6-week milestones).

Priya — welcome in advance — if you can confirm the preferred sanitized export format (CSV vs Parquet) and a single sample export by Monday, May 24, Ben can provision keys on May 21 and we can target ingestion the first week of June as requested.

I updated the MAP with the artifact handoff line you asked for (see Drive link). Action summary: 
- Procurement: Derek to confirm PO timeline and whether a pre-PO token can be issued for staging. (Derek — can you confirm?)
- Technical: Priya to share sanitized sample by May 24 (format + contact person)
- Redwood: Ben to provision staging keys and endpoint details by EOD May 21; Monica to share the initial eval rubric by May 25

Attachments: updated MAP link in Drive and SOW draft (DocuSign link above) — I’ll circulate redlines to the SOW after kickoff.

Thanks everyone — see you Thu.

Hannah
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
